note: Literature indicates PLP1-related disorders often display demyelinating peripheral neuropathy, whereas NKX6-2/SPAX8 peripheral myelin is generally spared or exhibits axonal involvement.

evidence.text: PLP1-related disorders present with mild spastic quadriparesis, ataxia, and mild multifocal demyelinating peripheral neuropathy.

source.title: PLP1 disorders
source.quote: by the absence of nystagmus and the presence of relatively mild spastic quadriparesis that mostly affects the legs, with ataxia and mild multifocal demyelinating peripheral neuropathy.
